reasoning: On the season so far the Celtics are the stronger team; with home court the Celtics start about 4 points better, in a game of about 221 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 3 points towards the Raptors.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Celtics win 53 times in 100, by about 1; most games like this end between 195 and 243 total points.

analyst.text: Boston play the night after an emotional, highly charged visit to Philadelphia to face Jaylen Brown. Toronto remain without Scottie Barnes, Immanuel Quickley and Kawhi Leonard (knee, about another week), and haven't won two in a row since opening week. A possible emotional hangover for Boston is offset by how short-handed the Raptors are, so the lean stays mild toward the Celtics.
